notes: Start at home. People say the Chinese market has peaked. That is only half true. Revenue has not peaked: in 2025 domestic game revenue was RMB 350.789 billion, up 7.68%, the third record year in a row, and the first half of 2026 was up another 12.17%. What has peaked is players: 683 million in 2025, up just 1.35%, and 684 million in June 2026, up 0.82%. The association said it in its own 2022 report: this is now a market of existing players. The figures come from the Game Publishing Committee of the China Audio-Video and Digital Publishing Association, CADPA for short.
